combo_label: Tools & DIY × Cycling × The Wild West

entries.clue: Slim steel spike driven flush with a few sharp taps
Curved shield that keeps road spray off your back on wet days
White, sticky and clamped overnight, it makes two offcuts one
Old cloth thrown over the furniture before the decorating begins
Arena contest of bull riding and roping, won for a prize buckle
Looped rope a rider whirls overhead to catch a running calf
Narrow blade that jitters up and down to cut a curve out of a board
Bare metal hoop that a tyre is stretched onto
Band of armed townsfolk riding out together to run down a gang
Pale paste run between bathroom tiles to close up the joins
One of the toothed rings on the back wheel that the chain runs over
Small toothed wheel, or a lowly worker in a vast machine
Guided trip round a city, or the great July race in France
